title: Pinolillo
desc: Drink it and you belong to them now
setting: Don Beto has handed you a jícara of something the colour of wet earth and is watching your face.

steps.speaker: Don Beto
steps.es: Tómeselo. Eso es pinolillo, hecho de maíz y cacao.
steps.en: Drink it. That is pinolillo, made of maize and cacao.

options.es: ¿De maíz? A ver. Gracias, don Beto.
options.en: Made of maize? Let us see. Thank you, don Beto.
options.feedback: Curiosity and then the drink. He is not offering you a drink, he is offering you the country.
Take it and drink it. The thanks matters less than the first swallow, which he is waiting for.
He just told you. Asking again sounds like you are looking for a reason not to.

options.es: Está bueno. Un poco espeso, pero está bueno.
options.en: It is good. A bit thick, but it is good.
options.feedback: Honest and warm at once. He asked for the truth and thick is the truth, so say it and then say you like it.
He will take it. He asked for the truth because he expected a face.
It is his childhood in a cup. Raro is not the word to reach for first.

steps.speaker: Don Beto
steps.es: Es que hay que batirlo bien. Si no, se va todo al fondo.
steps.en: The thing is you have to stir it well. If you do not, it all goes to the bottom.

options.es: Ah, por eso. ¿Y usted lo hace en la casa?
options.en: Ah, that is why. And do you make it at home?
options.feedback: You took the correction and asked him about his own. That is how an old man's afternoon opens up.
Correct. He had another twenty minutes on this subject and you did not ask for them.

options.es: En mi país no se toma esto.
options.en: In my country nobody drinks this.
options.feedback: True and beside the point. He is telling you how it is made here, not asking about there.

steps.speaker: Don Beto
steps.es: Por eso decimos que somos pinoleros. Del pinol, pues.
steps.en: That is why we say we are pinoleros. From pinol, you see.

options.en: So I am half a pinolero now.
options.feedback: The joke he was waiting for. Pinolero is what Nicaraguans call themselves, and claiming a bit of it is allowed once you have drunk it.
Polite and a little cold for a man who has just explained where his name for himself comes from.
He said it in the same sentence: del pinol. Listening to the end is half of this.
